The vendor directly providing **Pico** at **`picoapps.xyz`** is **WhimsyWorks, Inc.**

### Evidence
* Across official pages on **`picoapps.xyz`** (including the About, Pricing, and FAQ pages), the footer identifies the operating company and copyright holder as:  
  > *"Company WhimsyWorks Inc. Made in NYC"*  
  > *"© WhimsyWorks, Inc. All rights reserved."*
* The official About page (`picoapps.xyz/about`) is signed by founder & CEO Abi Raja on behalf of the company behind Pico.
